timeline.line: Airlines have suspended new bookings. With reservation systems offline, passengers are queuing for flights nobody can confirm.
Rolling brownouts are spreading. Utilities are rotating power between neighborhoods while crews struggle to keep the grid online.
Analogue television is back on air. Emergency bulletins are reaching homes through transmitters retired more than a decade ago.
Authorities are telling residents to keep battery radios nearby. Emergency schedules are now being read over AM and FM.
SJ goes on trial today, in a case already being called the trial of the century.
Prosecutors will try to show that he authored the AI worm responsible for the worldwide disruption.
